h1: Brush deburring machines and deburring benches — conveyor brush machines, a brushing workstation and crossed-belt benches
intro: Not every shop needs a wide-belt line. A brush deburring machine passes flat parts under cylindrical brushes on a conveyor and gives them a deburred, satin-finished surface at a fraction of the cost; a deburring workstation or bench lets the operator finish the parts no conveyor takes — heavy, thick, shaped, long or one-off. NovoTech sells three Gecam lines, built in Parma, Italy: the CUB 30, CUB 65BB and CUB 30B1B2 brush machines, 11-13/16″ and 25-9/16″ wide, with motorized pressure on every brush; the EASY T workstation, with a vacuum table and a two-tool brush arm that tilts through 180°; and the GCB 25, 30 and 40 benches, where two long crossed abrasive belts run over a motorized table up to 157-1/2″ long. Supplied with a CSA-approved panel, installed and supported from Mississauga, ON.
hero_points: CUB brush machines: 11-13/16″ and 25-9/16″ wide, parts to 9-13/16″ thick, conveyor 3.3 – 23 ft/min
EASY T: 31-1/2 × 51-3/16″ vacuum table, two tools on a 180° tilting arm, parts to 5-7/8″
GCB 25 / 30 / 40: two crossed belts over tables 98-7/16″ to 157-1/2″ long, suction-cup manipulator for shaped parts

faq.q: Brush machine or wide-belt deburring machine?
faq.a: A CUB brush machine deburrs and satin-finishes flat parts with cylindrical brushes — a clean, even finish and light deburring at a much lower price. Heavy burrs, edge rounding to a set radius and high volumes call for a wide-belt machine with an abrasive belt and top brushes, on the sheet metal deburring page.

faq.q: Which parts suit the EASY T?
faq.a: Parts a conveyor cannot carry or would not finish evenly: thick plates up to 5-7/8″, heavy brackets, shaped and bent parts, and single pieces. The vacuum table holds the part while the operator guides the brush; the second tool on the arm is a quick tilt away.

faq.q: What is a crossed-belt bench used for?
faq.a: Long and shaped parts — profiles, frames, panels, parts with flanges — that the operator deburrs, rounds and satin-finishes against the belt, choosing a roller, shoe or brush and its position along the belt for each job. The motorized table carries parts up to 220 lb, and the optional suction-cup manipulator holds shaped parts in any position.

faq.q: What voltage do these machines run on?
faq.a: Three-phase machines are supplied for 600 V as standard with a CSA-approved panel; 208 V, 240 V and 480 V 3-phase are available on request, and 240 V single-phase on models with a small enough motor. Manual machines have no electrics.
